prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
engine_stated_criteria: best broker for your exact situation
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” health insurance broker in Kansas City based on the search results, but **BBS Insurance**, **Benefit Services of Kansas City**, and **Apollo Health Insurance** are among the strongest locally visible options. BBS Insurance appears especially prominent in the results because it is directly described as a Kansas City health insurance broker and is also singled out in a local guide as a top trusted option for individuals, families, and small business owners.[3][5][7][11]

A practical way to choose is to match the broker to your situation:

| Broker | Best fit | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **BBS Insurance** | Individuals, families, small business owners, Medicare shoppers | Listed as a Kansas City health insurance broker with local contact details and broad service area coverage.[3][7] |
| **Benefit Services of Kansas City** | People comparing marketplace plans | Explicitly notes that brokerage services cost the same as going directly through the Marketplace for individual plans.[5][10] |
| **Apollo Health Insurance** | People who want a family-owned local broker | Described as a trusted, family-owned Kansas City broker.[6][11] |
| **HUB International** | Employer/group health benefits | Focuses on company health plans and long-term business coverage.[8] |

If your goal is to **pick an individual or family plan**, I would start with **BBS Insurance** and **Benefit Services of Kansas City** because the search results suggest they are geared toward consumer plan comparison rather than only employer coverage.[3][5][7][10] If you want a more business-oriented broker, **HUB International** is the clearest fit.[8]

When you call, ask each broker:
- Which carriers they represent in Kansas City
- Whether they can compare plans from multiple insurers
- How they help with doctors, prescriptions, and network checks
- Whether they charge any fee beyond commissions
- Whether they handle ACA/Marketplace plans, Medicare, or employer coverage

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best broker for your exact situation**—for example: **individual plan, family plan, self-employed, Medicare, or small business**.
